name: Tetsuko Umezawa, Fugitive
description: A hunted woman who opens magical doorways to slip refugees out of Phyrexia's clutches and is on the run again.

description_citations.text: "The Legends of Reality Fracture" by Meris Mullaley, Christopher Stuart-Reckling, K. Arsenault Rivera, DK Billins. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Sep 2026.

pages_say.description: A fugitive who boasts of making great bad choices and quotes her ancestor Toshiro.
